utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still set for Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, Sunday at the community center still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to confirm you're still in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — we still need a few people to sort supplies and greet folks on Sunday at the community center. If you can check in, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes — Sunday at the community center. I can check in and help sort supplies and greet folks for a few hours.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would be a huge help, Oren. Thank you — just come by Sunday at the community center when you can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sunday at the community center should be easier, but I’m a little worried about getting everything there on time. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help with the transport side—getting the supplies and tables over there on time. What’s the heaviest thing left?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Probably the folding tables and the tool bins are the heaviest. If you can handle those, I’ll make sure everything else is packed and labeled.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — it’s now on Sunday at the community center, and I’m still happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — Sunday at the community center works. What do you need most help with right now?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Probably organizing supplies and pointing folks to the right stations would help most. I can also check who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that’s right — Sunday at the community center. If you want, I can help figure out what time works best.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—Sunday at the community center works for me. Just send me the time and I’ll try to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — I’ll send you the time as soon as we nail it down.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — Sunday at the community center is the confirmed plan, and I’m still available to help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — please keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. I’ll spread the word to the block, and I appreciate you keeping an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — I’ll keep track of it and let you know if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. I’ll keep the block posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s the one — Sunday at the community center now. Folks are bringing donations and helping with neighborhood repairs, and Dane, your tool-gathering help would be great.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll focus on gathering tools and supplies, and I’ll swing by the community center Sunday to help out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for the Sunday details and the missing-supplies list. Happy to head over together after that.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it moved to Sunday at the community center—am I up to speed?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, that’s right—Sunday at the community center now. We could still use help with the tools and any small fixes, if you’re able.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can help with the tools and a few small fixes on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’m still in for the repair drive. Morning after drop-off works for me too—just tell me what time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — Sunday at the community center works for me. Just let me know the time, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Sunday at the community center — that works for me too. Just send me the time, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m still available to help with the repair drive. I’ve got the update that it’s Sunday at the community center, so just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Sam — could you help me spread the word and point people to Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll help spread the word and direct folks to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo. Just let me know what’s missing, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the supply list and let you know what’s missing for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Cleo. I’m ready to help once you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep Sunday open at the community center and wait for the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send the exact time as soon as it’s set, and I’m glad you’re keeping Sunday open at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Quinn — I’ll stay ready for Sunday at the community center and look for your message about the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Noah — I’m happy to help once you’ve checked. Just let me know what’s still needed for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, I’ll check what’s still needed for Sunday at the community center and let you know. Thanks, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Noah — I’m ready to pitch in once you’ve got the list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that’s right — Sunday at the community center. Sam’s still available to help, too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s Sunday at the community center now, and Sam’s still helping, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that’s right — Sunday at the community center, and Sam’s still helping.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’m still in for Sunday at the community center. Tell me what tools you need and I’ll bring them along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. If you can bring a screwdriver set and a cordless drill, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it—I’ll bring a screwdriver set and a cordless drill on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — it’s now on Sunday at the community center, and I’ll let you know as soon as we lock in the time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — Sunday at the community center works. Once the time’s set, I’ll help spread the word and bring anyone who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I really appreciate it, Opal. I’ll send the time along as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Nell — that sounds good. Let me know if anything else still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I heard the repair drive’s now Sunday at the community center, so I’ll pass that along if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks, Nell. I’ll be ready Sunday at the community center if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s on Sunday at the community center now. Send me the list, and I’ll see what I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — I’ll send the list right over. Really appreciate you pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — once you send it, I’ll check what we’ve got after school pickup and let you know what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes — it’s confirmed for Sunday at the community center. If you can help, sorting donations would be most useful right now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, Sunday at the community center — got it. I can help sort the donations Sunday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Sunday morning works — thanks, Oren. I’ll see you at the community center and we can sort donations together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I’m still available — and since it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, I can help there once I finish errands. What’s the biggest thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’s great — the biggest help is spreading the word and keeping people posted about the Sunday repair drive at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I can spread the word while I’m out and make sure folks know it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Sunday at the community center. Send the pickup, boxes, and tape details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll double-check the pickup details and gather the boxes and tape info before I send anything over.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send it over when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — Sunday at the community center is much easier to plan for. I’m just a little worried about getting the tools and supplies moved over on time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No worries — Cleo’s checking what we already have versus what we still need, so we can sort the tools and supplies in time. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — please do keep me posted. If you hear about any gaps or a last-minute pickup, I’d rather know early so we can sort the logistics.
